2 checklist items; please check for missing combined scenarios (e.g., what happens when Add reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke entry to validate.commands in lattice.config.json + Run lattice validate and confirm the new guard command executes and passes are performed simultaneously?)

story hit 1 high-risk signal(s): Validation Framework. Recommend stricter review standards (>= 3 preMortem scenarios, explicit rollback path). If this story only mentions rather than modifies that area (false positive), run lattice story_review_dismiss '{"storyId":"B-04bb","category":"<category>","reason":"..."}' to fully roll back the auto-elevation (after all auto-elevated riskSignals are dismissed, priority auto-reverts and high-risk gates are lifted).
High-risk story must fill decision.json (principles/drivers/options/chosen/>= 3 preMortem). Call: lattice decision_set '{...}'

CHK-002 missing verificationIntent.edge. The second-generation flow preserves happy/edge/adversarial test discipline: write intent in PLAN, cover via verification_evidence_add or validate in DEV/TEST.

understanding snapshot not filled. Recommend calling understanding_set before breaking down checklist to record the 6 fields task/outcome/facts/constraints/unknowns/touchpoints, avoiding expensive late fixes for misunderstandings
